Nina Parker hosts as the cast looks back at big moments from the season, including Rah Ali's beef with Yandy and Peter's love triangle, and a shocking secret is revealed.
Nina Parker and the cast discuss Cardi B's personality, DJ Self's messy love life, and Mendeecees's final moments of freedom, and Remy Ma performs her song 'Hands Down.'

A1 and Lyrica host a dinner that goes all the way left. Teairra discovers the shocking truth about Akbar. Ray J. tries to get Safaree to come clean. Brooke ambushes Marcus. Roccstar's collab with Amber gets a messy unveiling.
A scandal shakes Hollywood, with Teairra at the epicenter. Ray J. hits A1 with even more shocking intel. Moniece gives Jay Will advice that blows up in his face.

Teairra takes legal action against Akbar, testing her friendships with Nikki Baby and Paris. Kimberly launches her own investigation. Moniece dramatically collapses. Shun sees potential in Apple. Jay Will and La'Britney turn on one another.

Waka moves back into the house but is surprised by Tammy's independence. Rasheeda is shocked by a surprise visitor who has news about Jasmine's baby. The girls' trip to Jamaica gets off to a rocky start with uninvited crashers. Presented by VH1.

Kirk and Rasheeda finally talk. Dime gets the romantic surprise of a lifetime. Back in Atlanta, Jasmine gets an unwanted visit from her pesky ex-boyfriend. And Joseline reconsiders working things out with Stevie. Presented by VH1.

A phone call from home brings the Jamaica trip to an abrupt end. Rod checks Logan but has questions for Jasmine. Joseline has a surprise proposal for Stevie. Karlie takes one relationship to the next level and destroys another. Presented by VH1.

Stevie deals with the fallout of Joseline's botched apology to his daughters. Tommie and Dime agree to sit down to hash out their differences. Jasmine takes Kannon to get his DNA test. Kirk surprises Rasheeda on a cabin getaway. Presented by VH1.

Kirk reaches his breaking point and Rasheeda is rocked by DNA test results. Tommie and Samantha try to deal with their issues. Joseline wants Stevie to join her in NY and fire Estelita. Stevie makes a difficult decision. Presented by VH1.

The cast reunites as Nina Parker dives into the drama. Nobody knows if Joseline will confront her fellow cast. Mimi and Karlie exchange words. Stevie and Tommie spill the tea, but nothing compares to the tears shed for Rasheeda and Kirk. Presented by VH1.

The drama continues with Joseline backstage. Things with KK and Tommie get heated after their social media fiasco. The cast discuss their Jamaican adventure and we find out what really happened on the trip with Karlie and Joc. Presented by VH1.
